svg.title: Liveness and readiness probes
svg.desc: Pod 2 starts up and loads its model. Its liveness probe passes but readiness fails, so the service sends traffic only to Pod 1. Once the model is loaded readiness turns green and Pod 2 gets requests. Then Pod 2 deadlocks, liveness fails three times and the kubelet restarts it.
svg.text: Not ready means no traffic yet. Not alive means a restart.
